config.question: Does pre-touch 15m Pyharmonics confluence improve the unchanged original-score eight Monday1618 strategies?
config.single_variable: Change harmonic detection interval from5m to15m; retain1000bar/10spacing/3percent/forming80percent definition. Separately compare this gate with the unchanged original baseline.
config.fee_snapshot: OKX Lv1 2026-10-23; entry/target maker, other exits taker; native net already includes fees.
config.missing_score: V2/spike/allin3 accept missing scores. V3-family cannot choose the original score-based target, so records remain in coverage as unavailable, never imputed.
config.nonpositive_size: Original linear allocator clips nonpositive score-derived allocation to zero; preserve and count these unfunded opportunities.
config.add_gate: Retain original score>=0.6 add eligibility, -5percent level and parent-linked native cancellation; only primary admission is replaced.
config.control: Same pre-existing symbol/NY-week/side/prior14TR bucket random orders, unchanged native rules and zero unfilled controls. Generate only missing controls for harmonic-selected events. Additional incremental filter comparison uses week-clustered retained-minus-rejected means.
config.accounting: Reuse 20261028 allocator functions, original tie seeds/counts and annual restarts. All-in external replenishments are separate cashflow, never investment return. Per-trade worse OHLC/OLHC convention, original OHLC child-fill universe and realized-equity MAE liquidation proxy retained.
config.limitations: The owner explicitly requests the original fill-bar score convention, including its known lookahead. This is a historical replica comparison, not executable at the earlier fill. Rules/filter selected on the same history; no funding or exchange margin model; source Binance, paper OKX. BE17 remains unchanged, not the older booklet BE0 version.
config.reuse: All original signal fills and exact completed5m/15m/1h controls are reused. The two native-control arms run sequentially, whichever scan finishes first; only absent controls run. Cache order is operational, not an admission parameter.

harmonic.patterns: All library XABCD names; no ABC/ABCD-only candidates
harmonic.candidate: formed or forming at the latest same-side price pivot; XABC have full left/right peak_spacing observations
harmonic.confluence: Original 1.618 limit lies inside intersection of tolerance-adjusted X(A or C)D and BCD completion bands; direction matches trade
harmonic.invalidation: No earlier excursion past far PRZ edge after C; no return beyond C after D
harmonic.prz: Use search.PATTERNS ratio definitions; bullish anchor max(A,C), bearish min(A,C), matching library fib matrix. Do not use asymmetric bearish Pattern.completion_* helper.
harmonic.clock: Detection uses only complete UTC higher bars whose close is <= the original touch5m opening time. Never include the open higher bar. XABC confirmed; D may be provisional.
harmonic.missing: Explicit unavailable for insufficient higher-bar history, any incomplete/missing constituent in the lookback or incomplete pre-touch5m tail. Compare full and observable original baselines.
harmonic.candidate_validation: Reject forming() candidates whose actual XABC prices violate its own tolerance-adjusted XAB or ABC table; raw library joins retained. Source audit correction before return comparison.
harmonic.aggregation: Aggregate registered original5m OHLCV at UTC epoch-aligned left boundaries, require all3/12 constituents, no fill or interpolation.1000bars and spacing10 scale with the requested timeframe.
harmonic.invalidation_tail: Preserve zone invalidation through the exact pre-touch cutoff using completed5m tail after the last higher close; tail cannot form or confirm higher pivots.

harmonic_validation.correction: Before looking at returns, reject forming() joins whose actual XABC prices violate the same library ratio table. Raw candidates preserved; no rescan or parameter change.
